li.label: zealot of Atom
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has given {PAWN_possessive} whole self to Atom's cause. {PAWN_pronoun} sees radiation as a holy weapon and believes conversion - by word or by force - is a sacred duty. The Glow steadies {PAWN_possessive} nerves and stokes {PAWN_possessive} fervor, but {PAWN_possessive} zealotry unsettles those who do not share the faith.

li.label: congregant of Atom
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} reveres Atom without losing {PAWN_possessive} head. {PAWN_pronoun} studies radiation as a tool to be understood rather than a fire to be worshipped blindly, favoring careful research and diplomacy over fanaticism. {PAWN_possessive} measured faith earns the trust of believers and outsiders alike.
